zephyr-storage.efi: nvme0n1p1 (1GB vfat, /boot — separate, can install dual-boot bootloader)

ghost_drive_plan.strategy: shrink btrfs subvolume @, install Arch in freed space
steps: 2. btrfs filesystem resize -50G /@  (shrink root subvolume by 50GB)
5. Allocate 50GB new partition in freed space (ext4 or btrfs)
6. Install Arch Linux base into new partition
7. Install omarchy ISO overlay (themes, CLI, dots)
8. Install systemd-boot entries for both NixOS + Arch
9. First boot into NixOS, bind-mount new Arch partition at /mnt/arch
11. Port services: pipewire config, caddy systemd unit, peakminer unit
12. Port secrets: age keys (/etc/age/keys.txt), hermes .env, secretspec.toml
13. Reboot → select Arch from boot menu
ghost_drive_plan.rollback: Boot NixOS entry from systemd-boot menu — full state preserved
